annotations.title: chainpeek: the latest block number, timestamp and age of Ethereum, Base or Robinhood Chain

description: chainpeek: Get the latest block number, timestamp and age in seconds of Ethereum, Base or Robinhood Chain. For the full header use get_block; for chain id and gas price use get_chain_info. Returns the latest block. One RPC read. Ethereum, Base and Robinhood only. Read-only. Reads are cached up to 30 s. A bad chain is a 422 before any payment (not charged). Typically under 1 s. Price: USD 0.001. Free: 10 chain reads per IP per UTC day. Docs: https://tanod.dev/learn/ethereum-rpc-reads-api.html
